messages:
lina: Heads up — planning kernel + quant cutover (runtime-kernel v3.2-quant) tonight 23:00 UTC. Goal: swap matmul/int8 path, enable per-tenant compatibility guard. Need per-region staging, canary %, preflight checks, and explicit Dedicated image repack plan. Anyone with blockers?

mike: +1. Suggest EU first (low traffic window). We'll need a per-tenant routing matrix to avoid models pinned to matmul-v1.

tess: Packaging note: quant artifact changes the package layout (lib/abi.json moved). On-prem installers will need repack + new checksum. I'll add step in release notes.

raj: Telemetry gating: p50,p95,p99, error rate, correctness tests. Auto-pin thresholds: p95 +30ms OR error +0.5% OR any correctness test fail >=2 in 5m. Use 5m rolling with 3 consecutive windows.

oliver: I'll draft release notes. Need canary perf numbers and a short customer-facing blurb about negligible accuracy delta.

infra-oncall: Night window OK. We'll staff EU and NA oncall. Who owns the per-tenant pin map for Dedicated?

mike: I'll own the Dedicated mapping. Plan: apply per-tenant runtime label -> if tenant opts out, pin to v3.1-kernel. Need a migration checklist.

deploybot: deploybot: scheduling: 
```
/deploy runtime-kernel v3.2-quant --canary 1% --regions eu,na --hold 20m --monitor-channel #runtime-cutover
```

lina: Preflight checklist:
- binary signature checksum verify (sha256: abcd1234ef56...)
- KV-cache warmup (4k prefixes)
- synthetic matmul-heavy smoke (see gist)
- per-tenant routing audit
- Dedicated image repack + KMS env check

tess: Added pack step: repack-perms.sh -> ensures KMS env BIND_PATH applied. On-prem bundles will get new checksums.

raj: Add correctness harness: run 200 trace-based requests across top-10 models; fail if >1 mismatch.

deploybot: deploybot: canary started @2065432100 targeting engine-prod/slot-12 and engine-eu/slot-05. Watching #runtime-cutover.

infra-oncall: :eyes: watching. Will escalate on SLO breach. Also ensure rollback playbook is pinned to runbooks/runtime-cutover.

mike: Rollback playbook (short):
1) /deploy rollback runtime-kernel --to v3.1-kernel
2) restart affected pools if pinned fails
3) run smoke: curl -f https://smoke.runtime/redwood/health || echo FAIL
4) monitor #runtime-cutover for 30m

sara: I'll take ownership of the rollback runbook handoff and stand by until 01:00 UTC.

deploybot: deploybot: canary @15m: p95 delta +4ms, errors +0.01% — within gating. Continuing hold.

lina: Good. One more ask: add a 'compatibility matrix' field to release notes listing models that require matmul-v1 and recommended migration path.

oliver: Will append matrix + doc link. Final release doc: https://docs.internal/release/2026-04-runtime-kernel-v3.2-quant-compat

mike: Thanks. If we stay green at end of hold window, we proceed regional rollout. Ping here for any anomalies.

deploybot: deploybot: canary complete @2065435700 — metrics stable. Proceeding with staged rollout to NA.
